summary:
Iteration 20 — full Release-1 verification (backend + frontend) for the new CCDP × ANCR store, Invest page, Support page, nav restructure, and admin store orders. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_store.py (25 tests) covering: catalog shape (10 collections / 96 products / 12 types incl. THE RLMG and Nu RENSSNCE), customer register/login/me (bcrypt+JWT), duplicate-email 409, wrong-password 401, short-password 422, unauth 401, profile PUT persistence, addresses POST/GET/DELETE + auth guard, wishlist toggle (add→remove) + 404 for unknown product, guest checkout → Stripe (checkout_url starts with checkout.stripe.com, session_id + order_id returned, pending order persisted), logged-in checkout attaches user_id, checkout/status returns pending pre-payment, /store/orders scoped to customer & paid-only, admin /store/admin/orders shape {orders,total,paidCount,revenue} + auth guards (401 unauth, 403 for customer JWT), admin PATCH fulfillment_status persists (404 for unknown order), and REGRESSION on GET /api/config, POST /api/inquiries, GET /api/admin/inquiries — all 25 tests passed (100%) against the preview URL.

Frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080) verified: /store hero + 10 collection chips incl. THE RLMG and Nu RENSSNCE + category chips + 96 product-card-* grid + working quick-add-* that increments nav-cart-count (0→1); nav has nav-link-invest, nav-link-store (as `nav-link-{slug}` — see note), nav-cart-btn, nav-account-btn, nav-more-trigger dropdown listing all 5 items (Technology Ecosystem, Institutional Value, Leadership, Support Us, Resources); /store/product/ccdp-hoodie renders 6 size-* buttons, qty-plus/qty-minus, add-to-cart-btn and buy-now-btn (buy-now navigates to /store/cart); /store/cart cart-plus/cart-minus/cart-remove work, guest-email-input accepts email, checkout-btn redirects to https://checkout.stripe.com/... (Stripe hosted checkout page reached — hosted payment completion not executed per BEST-EFFORT); /store/login → tab-register + auth-name/email/password/auth-submit registers and redirects to /store/account; all four account tabs (orders/wishlist/addresses/profile) render, profile-save shows toast, addr-save persists an address (visible in list, 'Address saved.' toast); /invest hero + 'Too many talented creators...' intro paragraph verified, invest-cta-primary opens inquiry-dialog; /support hero + support-cta-primary opens inquiry-dialog; footer-contact-strip renders with contact-strip-web + contact-strip-mail (Visit CCDPbyANCR.com / AweDay.org / awe@aweday.org); /admin/orders after admin login shows admin-orders dashboard with stat-total-orders=7 and stat-revenue=$0.00 (no paid orders yet — Stripe not settled during test), 7 order-row-* rendered, shadcn fulfillment select opens and updating to 'processing' shows 'Order updated.' toast and PATCH persists; regressions Home / /platform / /framework load with no console errors.
action_items: MINOR: PATCH /api/store/admin/orders/{order_id} accepts any string for fulfillment_status (Field(min_length=1,max_length=40)); the AdminOrders UI whitelist is [unfulfilled, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled]. My test run set 'in_production' via backend which now renders as an empty SelectValue in the UI for that row. Recommend enforcing a Literal/enum server-side so bad values 400 and UI never desyncs.

MINOR: React console warning on /store/login — 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (StoreLogin). setState-in-render'. Likely a navigate() called synchronously during render (e.g. redirect-if-already-logged-in path). Wrap in useEffect. Non-blocking, but noisy in prod console.

MINOR (spec/testid drift): review_request references nav-invest / nav-store; actual Navbar uses nav-link-invest / nav-link-store (via `nav-link-${slug}`). Behavior is correct — either align the testids or update the spec. Same for admin fulfillment select: request expects fulfillment-select-*; code uses fulfillment-${order_id}. Also stat-paid-orders testid referenced in spec is not implemented (Paid orders card has no data-testid; only stat-total-orders and stat-revenue exist).
NICE-TO-HAVE: admin orders 'Paid orders' card should get a data-testid (e.g. stat-paid-orders) to match the ecosystem's other stat testids and the review spec.
critical_code_review_comments: Server-side validation gap on OrderStatusBody.fulfillment_status — accept any 1..40 char string. Since the storefront and admin UI depend on 5 fixed states, this should be a typing.Literal[...] or Enum in store.py to prevent arbitrary values (which today render as an empty shadcn Select trigger, as observed on row ord_a63d4104fe12).
StoreLogin.jsx triggers setState during render (React warning captured). If it's an 'already-authed → redirect to /store/account' branch, move the navigate() into useEffect so it fires after commit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (Stripe hosted payment completion intentionally skipped per BEST-EFFORT clause)

seed_data_creation: Backend test suite created ~7 TEST_ orders (guest + logged-in checkouts) via POST /api/store/checkout (all pending, none paid), 1 TEST_ customer via /store/auth/register (test_cust_<uid>@example.com), plus 1 TEST_ address & wishlist toggles. Frontend UI test created 1 more customer (qa_ui_<ts>@example.com) with an address, and additional pending guest orders from cart→checkout flows. Also 1 TEST_ inquiry via public POST /api/inquiries as regression check. Per policy no existing CRM/store data was deleted.
test_credentials: Admin: danielle@aweday.org / QnCggaMbqI4PjUl8XiisRrhW (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Customer accounts are self-service via POST /api/store/auth/register.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 25 store backend tests + all UI flows green on preview URL. Stripe checkout redirect verified — hosted payment (test card 4242…) not completed by the automated run; if needed, script the Stripe hosted page separately. Real testids: nav-link-invest / nav-link-store (NOT nav-invest/nav-store), fulfillment-${order_id} (NOT fulfillment-select-*). AdminOrders currently only has stat-total-orders and stat-revenue testids (Paid orders card has none). Server accepts any fulfillment string; use only 'unfulfilled|processing|shipped|delivered|cancelled' from tests so the UI stays consistent.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional defects. Two minor code-quality issues surfaced: (1) OrderStatusBody has no enum/Literal on fulfillment_status, so an arbitrary admin-PATCH value leaves the shadcn <Select value=...> without a matching <SelectItem>, rendering an empty trigger; (2) StoreLogin performs a setState/navigate during render (React setstate-in-render warning). Both are contained, non-blocking, and already fixable with tiny edits (Literal enum + useEffect wrap).
